name: jee-tracker-push-scheduler
description: Scheduled job for the JEE Tracker app: reads each signed-in user's notification settings from Firestore, decides which reminders are due right now, and sends them as FCM push messages — so alarms can reach a device even when no browser tab is open. Triggered every 5 minutes by ../.github/workflows/scheduled-alarms.yml (free GitHub Actions cron). See ../PUSH_SETUP.md for setup.
